start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
user -> app: login
alt [valid]
  app --> user: token
else [invalid]
  app --> user: error
end
user -> app: logout
@enduml

after.properties:
- region "Relation — app → user":
  - heading "Relation — app → user" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Synchronous"
    - option "Asynchronous"
    - option "Return" [selected]
    - option "Async reply"
    - option "Create"
    - option "Lost"
    - option "Found"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "user"
    - option "app" [selected]
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "user" [selected]
    - option "app"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label": token
  - button "Invert direction"
  - group "Message order":
    - text: Message order
    - button "Move earlier"
    - button "Move later"
  - text: Branch
  - combobox "Branch":
    - 'option "1: alt [valid]"'
    - 'option "2: else [invalid]" [selected]'
  - paragraph: Drag a message line up or down to reorder it, or press Delete to remove it.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
